intro.title: A small farm with a simple promise
paragraphs: In the heart of Chettinad, we look after our cows the way families here always have – with patience, clean water, green fodder and plenty of open space.
We started Kamadhenu Dairy because we wanted our own children to drink milk we could trust. Today we share that same milk with families around us: nothing added, nothing taken away.

promise.intro: Good milk doesn't need clever marketing. It needs healthy cows, clean hands and a short trip to your door.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To bring fresh, honest milk from native cows to families in Chettinad every morning – nothing added, nothing taken away.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: A future where every home around us can get its milk from a farm it knows and trusts, and where native cattle and traditional dairy skills keep thriving.

a2.title: A2 milk, explained simply
a2.intro: No jargon and no tall claims – just what A2 means and why we chose native cows.

whatIs.title: What does “A2” mean?
whatIs.text: Cow's milk contains a protein called beta-casein, which comes in two common types: A1 and A2. Native Indian breeds are known to carry mostly the A2 type, so their milk is called A2 milk. That's all the name means.

nativeCows.title: Why native cows?
nativeCows.text: Native breeds are at home in our hot Chettinad weather and have been part of Tamil village life for generations. Raising them helps keep these breeds – and the know-how around them – alive.

honest.title: What we don't claim
honest.text: We won't tell you A2 milk is a cure or a medicine – research on A1 and A2 milk is still going on. What we can promise is fresh milk from well-cared-for cows. For any health question, please ask your doctor.
